name: Mohenjodaro
description: A Saraswati valley city at the desert's edge, downriver of Harappa.
notes: `event_founding_lothal` records the Mask Family's migration from Mohenjodaro as a cause. The origin was in canon; the place was not. Raised by people, so it begins with them.
